en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a historic European city. On the left is the corner of a building with a bay window and iron balcony. A curved street runs downhill along a wall, leading toward a dense cluster of old rooftops. In the distance a large medieval church with a very tall, slender spire dominates the skyline. There is a printed caption at the bottom and a red postage stamp with a circular postmark at the upper right.
